long_biography.plain_text:
The opportunity behind Jamie Waller's first major company came from observing how traffic penalties were issued but not collected. After early ventures in window cleaning and used cars, he established JBW to provide outsourced collections services. He built the business over more than a decade before selling his stake in stages.

Waller led the acquisition of Arum Global, a specialist in collections and recoveries advice, technology and managed services. He remains its group chief executive and executive chair, with Just operating within the same wider group. His books Unsexy Business and The Dyslexic Edge draw on his business career and his experience of dyslexia, giving a public voice to overlooked enterprises and different ways of thinking.

uncertainties.detail: The JBW staged exit and current Arum/Just executive roles are well documented. Publisher copy also mentions equity investments and property, but no current asset breakdown shows those holdings exceeding the collections-services group. Current Service classification therefore follows the strongest material operating platform; exact equity percentages and proceeds are not asserted.

The independent-start subtype rests on positive childhood and early-venture reporting, not merely a lack of inheritance reporting. Original JBW seed-capital terms are unpublished; an ordinary support programme or career training would not itself constitute a substantial family-wealth platform.

Companies House supports February 1979 but not a birth day. Pan Macmillan supports Bethnal Green as birthplace. The linked LinkedIn and personal domain are authenticated by independent interview and publishing sources, while similarly named biopharma and running profiles are excluded. Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube and TikTok searches did not establish another personal URL to the required standard.

Forbes contains his former contributor articles but no dedicated person profile. The catalogue has no active debt-collection or recoveries literal; inactive Business services and Entrepreneurship author are not assigned. Active Author fits his two published books and continuing public author identity and is the only proposed tag.
